newsitem.title: USA: Dow index soars 95 points; posts biggest weekly gain ever.
newsitem.headline: Dow index soars 95 points; posts biggest weekly gain ever.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average soared nearly 95 points Friday, coming within a few points of a new high and posting its biggest weekly gain ever on news of a plan to balance the U.S. federal budget.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow was up 94.72 points, or 1.36 percent, to close at 7,071.20. For the week, it was up a record 332 points, which beat the old high of 312 points set on April 18.
In the broader market, advancing issues swamped declines by a huge 5-to-1 margin on heavy volume of 500 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
